Agent C, new and non-blocking: the D4 guard makes two defensive else branches in flush() unreachable - 'start_line if start_line is not None else 1' and 'end_line if ... else start_line or 1'. start_line can now be None only when every buffered line was blank, in which case the body is empty and the readable-signal gate rejects the chunk. Instrumented over 40,000 chunk_note calls: zero hits on either branch. Untestable-by-construction code; worth a cleanup note, not a repair here.

Agent C, forward coupling for whoever takes D1: the span guard asks whether the RAW line carries text, not whether it survives markup cleanup. That is exact today only because D1 leaves the cleanup regexes inert, so every non-blank line reaches the body. Once D1 is repaired, a chunk whose last line is a rule or an HTML comment will report an end_line pointing at a line no longer in its body. D1's package must re-check spans.
